Mods.Empty: Drop a mod here (e.g. silencer, scope, armor modification) from a compendium or the Items directory.

Catalog.Locked: The compendium "{name}" is locked; unlock it to add items.

KarmaVote.NoSelf: Players do not vote for their own character
KarmaVote.Hint: Click how much Karma you suggest for each character (0–{max}). You can change your vote until it closes.
KarmaVote.HintNoSelf: Click how much Karma you suggest for each character (0–{max}) except your own. You can change your vote until it closes.

Chargen.Title: Character creator
Chargen.Name: Name / handle
Chargen.ConceptHint: e.g. ork street samurai from Puyallup
Chargen.PriorityHint: Pick each row A–E once (pp. 63–64). Metatype shows adjustment points in brackets.

MagicNote.mystic: Mystic adept: powers for up to {magic} Magic, the remaining Magic × 2 are spells.

Chargen.AttributeHint: Every attribute starts at 1. Attribute points: physical and mental attributes. Adjustment points: Edge, Magic/Resonance and racial attributes (above 6). "+Karma": further ranks at 5 × new rank. Only one attribute may be at its maximum.
Chargen.SkillHint: Max 6 (7 with Aptitude), only one skill at the maximum. A specialization costs 1 skill point or 5 Karma (tick "with Karma"); at most one per skill.
Chargen.QualityHint: At most 6 qualities (racial ones aside), and negative qualities may give at most 20 Karma more than the positive ones cost (p. 66).
Chargen.VariableKarma: Karma for this quality (e.g. allergy: 20 − allergen − severity)
Chargen.KarmaToNuyenDebt: In Debt: 1 Karma = 5,000¥ and 5,000¥ of debt (p. 77).
Chargen.ContactHint: Charisma × 6 points for Connection and Loyalty, no rating above Charisma (p. 67).
Chargen.KnowledgeHint: Free: as many knowledge and language skills as Logic, plus one native language. Each further one costs 3 Karma.
Chargen.SummaryHint: After creating the character, buy gear by dragging catalog items onto the sheet (the purchase dialog takes the nuyen). At most 5,000¥ may be kept for play; spend the rest (a Lifestyle too).
Chargen.FixErrors: Fix the errors before creating the character.

Error.MagicRow: This magic type is not available in row {row}.

Error.SkillTwoAtMax: Only one skill may be at its maximum.

Error.ExceptionalOnce: Exceptional can be bought only once (errata 08/2019, p. 71).

Sheet.Name: Name

Sheet.NoGear: No gear — drag it from the catalog.

Give.Title: Give: {name}
Give.NoRecipients: There are no other player characters to give the item to.

ItemSheet.Label: Edge sheet (Shadowrun Edge)

ItemSheet.Unknown: This item type has no panel of its own yet — edit its other fields on the system sheet.
ItemSheet.DropMod: Drop a mod here from the catalog or the character's inventory

Actions.major: Major action (click to spend or give back)
Actions.minor: Minor action (click to spend or give back)

Setting.Name: Action tracker in the combat tracker
Setting.Hint: Squares (Major action) and circles (Minor: 1 + 1 per initiative die) next to combatants. They come back at the start of each round.

Defend.Hint: The caster has {hits} hits — ties go to the defender.
Defend.NoDefender: Select the token of the defending character.
Defend.Label: Defense against: {item} ({attrs}, caster hits: {hits})
Defend.Title: Target's defense
Defend.TitleHint: attributes the target defends with (see the spell's text)
Defend.HintAttacker: The caster has {hits} hits — ties go to the attacker (errata 02/2020, p. 105), so the defender needs more hits.

aug2019.Name: SR6 errata: August 2019
aug2019.Hint: Catalyst's official core rulebook errata (August 2019). Off = first-print text. In the module: Exceptional bought only once (p. 71); no wound modifiers on recovery (p. 121); each hit reduces scatter (p. 114); thrown grenade AR from the unarmed AR (p. 115); launchers: Exotic Weapons + AGI (p. 263); banishing drain Physical by the drain after resistance (p. 147); Cover IV: −2 to attacks (p. 52).

feb2020.Name: SR6 errata: February 2020
feb2020.Hint: Catalyst's official errata (February 2020); wins over the earlier one where both change the same rule. In the module: ties in opposed tests go to the attacker (p. 105); Exceptional once per attribute (p. 71); medkit rating + Logic as an alternative (p. 120); maximum Magic/Resonance 6 + grade − 1 per full point of Essence lost (p. 167, 195).

Heal.Title: Healing: {name}
Heal.Kit: I have a first aid kit (without one −2 dice and no Edge)
Heal.UseMedkitRating: Roll medkit rating + Logic instead of Biotech (errata 02/2020, p. 120)
Heal.Assistance: Medical attention (someone with Biotech for half the rest): +2 dice
Heal.DrainBoxes: Of the Stun, boxes from drain (not healable)
Heal.ManualHits: Hits from your own roll (empty = roll here)
Heal.ManualHitsPlaceholder: e.g. from a spell roll with Edge
Heal.Hint: Overflow always heals first. First aid within a minute after combat, medkit within an hour; each of them and magic works once per set of injuries (pp. 119–121). Threshold: 5 − patient's Essence; a fully natural patient gives +1 hit.
Heal.UsedWarning: This method was already used on this set of injuries — by the rules it doesn't work again (the GM decides).
Heal.Dead: {name} has Overflow equal to BOD × 2 — the character is dead, beyond healing (p. 121).
Heal.HintShort: Overflow heals first. First aid, medkit and magic work once per set of injuries; they don't heal drain.

Blast.ExplosivesHint: thrown or launched, scatter and zones (pp. 114–117)
Blast.PanelHint: DV at Ground Zero (within 1 m), Close (1–3 m), Near (4 m – radius)
Blast.FromNote: read from the catalog note — change to store your own
Blast.Airburst: Airburst: hits count double against scatter
Blast.Hint: After 'Pick target' click a point on the scene (Esc or right click cancels). The distance from your token sets the range; scatter is 2D6 − (hits + range modifier), direction from the scatter diagram.
Blast.PickPoint: Click the point on the scene you aim at.
Blast.NoBlastData: {name}: no blast data — fill it in on the Edge item sheet (Blast panel).
Blast.NoScene: Throwing a grenade needs an active scene.
Blast.CardThrown: Thrown: pool {pool}, hits {hits}, range {range}, throw AR {ar} (errata 08/2019: unarmed AR).
Blast.NoOne: Nobody was in the blast radius.
Blast.CardHint: Everyone in the radius resists with BOD (vehicles BOD × 2). The GM handles the Avoid Incoming action; Hit the Dirt lowers the DV by 2.
Blast.NotOwner: The character's owner or the GM rolls the resistance.
Blast.HintShort: Then click a point on the scene (Esc cancels) — the module rolls 2D6 scatter and direction.
Blast.Title: Grenade: {name}
Blast.OtherScene: The blast can only go off on the scene where it was thrown.
Blast.ExplodeHint: Scatter uses the hits at the moment of the click, so Edge spent after the roll counts.
Blast.EdgeGain: {name}: +1 Edge for the area attack advantage (AR {ar} vs highest DR {dr}).
Blast.EdgeYes: Advantage: AR {ar} vs highest DR {dr} — the attacker gained +1 Edge.
Blast.EdgeNo: Advantage: AR {ar} vs highest DR {dr} — no Edge.
Blast.Avoiders: Avoiding: {names} — move the token before the blast.
Blast.AvoidSelect: Select your token on the scene.
Blast.AvoidUsed: {name} already used Avoid Incoming this round.
Blast.AvoidNow: {name}: move the token (up to the Move rate). Over 2 m = Prone for damage resistance.
Blast.NoPoint: The spot on the scene could not be read — pick it again.

Summon.Title: Summoning: {name}
Summon.Info: Conjuring + Magic: pool {pool}. Magic {magic}: active spirits total Force {used} of {max} (Magic × 3).
Summon.Reagents: Spend reagents equal to the Force: +1 Edge (add it to a roll with Edge and type the hits in)
Summon.Hint: The spirit rolls Force × 2 dice. At least one net hit is needed; services = net hits. Drain = the spirit's hits, Physical if higher than Magic (p. 146). The spirit leaves after one sunrise and one sunset.
Summon.OverBudget: The combined Force of active spirits would exceed Magic × 3 ({max}) — not allowed by the rules.
Summon.Created: {name} appears: {services} services, optional powers to choose: {powers}.
Summon.CardHint: If the drain knocks the summoner out, the spirit returns to its metaplane.
Summon.TargetSpirit: Pick a spirit token (target or selection).
Summon.Departs: The spirit has no services left — it returns to its metaplane.
Summon.BanishDrainFinal: Drain = 2 × the spirit's hits; Physical if it still exceeds Magic {magic} after resistance (errata 08/2019, p. 147).
Summon.BanishDrainInitial: Drain = 2 × the spirit's hits; Physical if it exceeds Magic {magic}.
Summon.DismissConfirm: Dismiss {name}? The spirit actor is deleted.
Summon.ForceLabel: Spirit Force ({left} of the limit free)
Summon.Forecast: About {services} services on average · drain ~{drain} (spirit hits), Physical above {magic}
Summon.BanishHintShort: Each net hit removes one service; drain = 2 × the spirit hits.
Summon.CardHintEdge: The result follows Edge spent after the roll. The button creates the spirit; resist drain through the system soak card.
Summon.OverBudgetDetail: Force {force} is over the free Force limit ({left} of {max} = Magic × 3).

Traits.FocusEffect: Focused Concentration (Add level: sustain 1 more spell/complex form without penalty)
Traits.PainEffect: Pain Resistance (Add level; negative = penalties earlier)

Warn.panicked: Panicked: can only act to avoid the cause of the panic.
Warn.stilled: Stilled: only Perception and mental communication.

Status.NauseaFail: Failure ({hits} hits): cannot take an action this round.

Status.BarrierNote: Subtracts half the Structure (rounded up) from the damage. If that is more than the weapon base DV, there is no damage — the GM decides.

Summary.blinding: −3 per level to sight tests; III: automatic failure
Summary.burning: {n} Physical damage at the end of each round; put out with AGI + REA (2)
Summary.chilled: Initiative −4; −1 to pools except Damage Resistance
Summary.corrosive: {n} Physical damage at the end of each round
Summary.cover: +{n} to DR and Defense tests; attacking from cover: +1 Minor Action, no Edge
Summary.dazed: Initiative −4; cannot gain or spend Edge
Summary.deafened: −3 per level to hearing tests; III: automatic failure
Summary.fatigued: −{n2} to pools except Damage Resistance; move 5/10 m
Summary.frightened: −4 to tests against the source and defense against it
Summary.hazed: cannot project or manifest (can perceive astrally)
Summary.immobilized: cannot move; AR −3, −3 to attacks; no Reaction on defense

Summary.panicked: can only act to avoid the cause
Summary.petrified: no actions; +10 Armor; cancels damaging statuses
Summary.poisoned: {n} damage at the end of each round, then −1

Note.truthSerum: After the main effect: truth serum (WIL −3, min. 1).
